title: Repair the Durable Registry Git commit identity contract

phases.objective: Replace SHA-256-only validation of schema source/runtime commits with an exact Git object identity validator while preserving all digest and authority boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 Durable Authorized Injection Registry constructor
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Secret-free Schema Verification v2 evidence carrying exact Durable Injection schema binding and a 40- or 64-character lowercase Git object identity
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both supported Git identity lengths construct the canonical Registry without database access, malformed identities fail with a commit-specific code, and SHA-256 digest plus source/runtime parity checks remain unchanged.
steps: Build exact Durable Injection schema evidence with the canonical contract key, digest, and two-table set.
Construct the Registry with the current 40-character Integration Git commit and prove exact identity preservation.
Construct the Registry with a 64-character Git object identity and prove exact identity preservation.
Reject uppercase, non-hexadecimal, truncated, overlong, and unsupported identity lengths with STORAGE_DURABLE_INJECTION_COMMIT_INVALID.
Reject valid but different source/runtime identities with STORAGE_DURABLE_INJECTION_RUNTIME_PARITY_REQUIRED.
Retain SHA-256-only validation for evidence_digest and database_fingerprint.
Prove constructor-only validation opens no database connection and grants no migration, provider, deployment, or Production authority.
assertions: Exact lowercase 40- and 64-character Git object identities are accepted.
Lengths 39, 41, 63, and 65 are rejected without truncation.
Uppercase and non-hexadecimal identities are rejected.
Evidence digests and database fingerprints still require exact SHA-256 bindings.
Source and deployed-runtime identities must remain identical.
No SQL connection, live database access, migration Apply, Provider dispatch, deployment, main merge, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Use the repaired Registry only after separately governed live migration, same-cycle readback, and signed verification evidence exists.
Carry exact commit identity and parity checks through restart reconciliation and persisted durable state readback.
No live canary is appropriate for this repository-only validator repair.
This validator repair grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
